Name: Split Screen Manager
Author: RomenH
Description:
[b]Split Screen Manager[/b] lets you customize the positions for each player when using local multiplayer.
The way the screen can be divided up for 2 - 4 players is completely unconstrained too!

This works by replacing the game's hard-coded split screen viewports with viewports provided by this mod's config file.
You can even adjust the viewports while the game is running if you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] installed.


[size=4][b]Install[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]This mod will also install correctly with Vortex.


[b][size=4]Compatibility[/size][/b]
[list]
[*]Supports Stardew Valley 1.5.6 or newer, requires SMAPI 3.14 or newer.
[*]This mod should be compatible with all other mods as I am unaware of any other mods that patch the same section of code as this one.
[/list]
